text:
mika: Heads up — planned unpin of runtime 2.14 -> 3.0 canary tonight 23:00 PT. We have a quantized long-seq regression in eu-west. Thinking staggered waves + SDK lock. Any concerns?

jonah: Which models are showing the regression?

mika: quant-v4b and llama3q longseq paths. Repro in canary: kvcache mismatch then OOM on warmup. Logs attached in thread.

sasha: If we unpin runtime globally customers will hit fallbacks. Recommend pin runtime in eu-west for 12h and unpin everywhere else. Staggered is safer.

pratik: Alternatively pin the model variant to a stable quant build while we hold the runtime. That avoids changing runtime routing for unrelated models.

mika: Good call. Also want to lock SDK to 1.7.2 for canary callers to avoid new batching semantics. @devx can we publish a short advisory?

devx: Will do — drafting now. Short note to release channel + docs.

mika: deploybot, apply model pin in eu-west (12h) please.

deploybot: Executing command:
```
/deploy pin model quant-v4b-stable --region eu-west --ttl 12h --initiator=mika
```

deploybot: Success — pin applied. pin-id: pin-3180300000-eu. Affected routes: /generate (quant-v4b, llama3q-longseq).

jonah: I'll monitor canary metrics. Watch for p50/p95 regressions and 5xx.

sasha: Runbook note: if OOMs persist after model pin, next step = soft rollback runtime -> 2.14 in eu-west. Who owns rollback?

pratik: I'll own rollback execution and monitoring. Add me to oncall for the window.

mika: Checklist before escalation:
1) confirm deploy metrics warming within 10m
2) verify KV cache warming logs (kvcache: warmed=true)
3) confirm no increase in 5xx rate for canary
4) snapshot traces and upload (trace id prefix: canary/31803)
5) postmortem doc placeholder: /notebooks/incident-3180300000

ivy: Uploaded heap dump and jstack: s3://redwood-debug/3180300000/heap.tgz and s3://redwood-debug/3180300000/jstack.txt

jonah: If everything looks green we'll unpin for us-west tomorrow 02:00 PT. If not, we hold and escalate.

mika: :thumbsup: I'll update the release board and ping enterprise-svcs for any affected contracts.

deploybot: Scheduled unpin event created: unpin-id unpin-3180300000-w1 scheduled_at=3180386400 (2026-03-22T02:00:00Z)

sasha: Add to release notes: "SDK 1.8.x changes batching semantics — for current canary pin to SDK 1.7.2 until compatibility checks finish."

pratik: Quick rollback command (if needed):
```
/deploy rollback runtime 3.0 --region eu-west --force --reason "canary oom"
```
Note: confirm no runtime DB migrations in 3.0 before rolling back.

mika: Thanks all. I'll close this thread after the unpin runs or if we perform a rollback. Please post short updates here (one-line) when you see green/hold/fail.

jonah: Green at +12m on p95 and no new 5xx — monitoring continues.

pratik: Oncall ready. I have the rollback command queued but holding.

ivy: Heap analysis shows a transient warmup spike, not a leak — attaching summary.

mika: Great. Leaving pin in place until the scheduled unpin. Will re-open if anything changes. Thanks!
